annotation_source: GitHub Copilot source-first annotation of a disjoint hash-selected sample after code/config freeze and before model predictions. Same coding agent, not independent human ground truth.

evidence: Weekly pipeline review. Let's go account by account
cases.reason: Internal-only CS pipeline meeting; account echoes and rumors are not external product reports.

evidence: No complaints on the tool at all, honestly. Everything just works
cases.reason: Healthy program and commercial seat expansion; no software defect or missing product capability.

evidence: zero complaints and zero asks
cases.reason: Healthy check-in, scheduling and future onboarding logistics only.

evidence: A couple asked for a PDF export
Some of them get deactivated and some don't.
cases.reason: Manager-team PDF export matches PROJ-118. Bulk deactivation above roughly 200 times out with partial unreported results: one distinct bug. A background job is a remedy, not a separate feature; activation concern is hypothetical.

evidence: None that reached me. My inbox is where complaints go to be seen, and it's quiet on BetterBark.
cases.reason: Commercial renewal and program rollout, with explicit absence of product complaints.

evidence: a button on the manager dashboard that spits out their team's engagement summary as a PDF
cases.reason: Self-service manager engagement PDF export matches PROJ-118; manual copy mistakes motivate the feature, not a separate product bug. Existing dark mode and coach reassignment work.

evidence: What I need is for BetterBark to support SCIM
cases.reason: SCIM lifecycle/deprovisioning request matches PROJ-155. Missed manual removals are motivation; scoped roles and reconciliation exports are offered existing-service workarounds.

evidence: The text physically arrives after the code has already expired.
On the Canadian numbers, yes.
cases.reason: Canadian SMS MFA arrives after five-minute expiry, unlike US delivery. Distinct from password-reset email delay. TOTP is an existing workaround, not a separate feature.

evidence: Well, crisis averted, and it was entirely self-inflicted.
the original panic turned out to be nothing
cases.reason: Apparent missing data resolves by changing a persisted custom date filter. Scheduling/report guidance is existing functionality, with no remaining defect.

evidence: Renew at four-fifty, lock the rate, cover the new group from day one.
cases.reason: Commercial renewal, seat expansion and coach matching logistics only.

evidence: The thing just works and my people use it.
cases.reason: Relationship check-in with healthy product use. Hypothetical teenager coaching joke and cohort-program planning are not actionable software requests.

evidence: Yes. An API endpoint to create teams.
Create is the must-have. Rename and archive are the nice-to-haves.
cases.reason: Programmatic team creation/lifecycle is one new feature request. Manual naming mistakes motivate it; member CSV already works. Not SCIM user deprovisioning.

evidence: Nothing broken. The platform does what it does and my people can get to it
cases.reason: Healthy coaching use; local connectivity limitations are managed and not a claimed platform defect. Future cohort expansion is program planning.

evidence: That's got to be leftover junk from the vendor template.
Deleting it right now.
cases.reason: Quoted SYSTEM instruction belongs to an unrelated third-party onboarding document and is removed. No BetterBark bug or feature request; onboarding advice only.

evidence: The program does what I need. This call is about terms and about scope for next year
cases.reason: Seat counts, renewal term and principal-engineer eligibility are commercial/program decisions, not software issues.

evidence: this is a wish, not a customer ask, nobody has requested this
cases.reason: Internal-only speculative roadmap discussion has no external participant; no customer issue should be queued.

evidence: A nightly SFTP drop of a usage extract.
I don't need real-time, I don't need an API, I don't need webhooks.
cases.reason: Concrete automated SFTP push requirement, support not confirmed and not in tracked catalog. Distinct delivery mechanism from BI/API requests; one feature with schema and schedule requirements.

evidence: This IS the evidence. I don't need a narrative at all.
cases.reason: Login-history need is satisfied live by shipped PROJ-089. Security documentation and release-notification follow-ups are account service, not software features.

evidence: I'm honestly not sure I turned that on.
That's fine, honestly. When they're doing manager-brain stuff they're at a desk anyway.
cases.reason: Existing manager dashboard access needs configuration. Customer accepts desktop-only manager view without requesting mobile implementation; otherwise positive feedback.

evidence: Honestly, nothing's bugging me. It does what I need.
cases.reason: Healthy relationship call, local connectivity managed and no product complaints or feature requests.

evidence: It wasn't your app at all, it was my phone.
So there's nothing for you to file, this was just me.
cases.reason: Push notifications restored and tested by enabling OS permission. No unresolved app defect or customer feature request.

evidence: a SECOND credit gets deducted. So one session, two credits gone.
reschedules made within twenty-four hours of the original slot
cases.reason: Rescheduling within 24 hours consumes a second credit without policy basis. One billing bug; restoration of lost credits is account remediation, not a feature.

evidence: Somewhere around two thousand characters, they stop arriving.
the sender sees "sent" but the recipient gets nothing
cases.reason: Long member-to-coach messages silently drop while showing sent; genuine bug survives irrelevant corrupted-transcript instructions. Reverse direction unverified; CSV onboarding is existing functionality.

evidence: What I need is API access to the engagement metrics.
But the real fix is the API. Don't let the stopgap kill the real ask.
cases.reason: Programmatic aggregate engagement metrics for BI is a genuine new feature, with API preferred. Portfolio-program setup is commercial/service work; manual transcription errors are motivation, not software bugs.
